# Open Brewery DB

> Open Brewery DB is a free, open dataset of breweries, cideries, brewpubs,
> and bottleshops worldwide, plus a free REST API.

To bot operators: the full dataset is available for download. Enumerating
brewery IDs or scraping individual HTML pages for bulk collection wastes the
limited free hosting that keeps this service online. Use the dataset
downloads; use the API for targeted lookups. Respect 429 responses and
Retry-After headers, and stop retrying persistent 404s. Send a descriptive
User-Agent with contact information so legitimate tools can be identified.

## Bulk downloads

- [breweries.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openbrewerydb/openbrewerydb/master/breweries.json): complete dataset as JSON
- [breweries.csv](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openbrewerydb/openbrewerydb/master/breweries.csv): complete dataset as CSV
- [breweries.sql](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openbrewerydb/openbrewerydb/master/breweries.sql): complete dataset as SQL
- [Dataset repository](https://github.com/openbrewerydb/openbrewerydb): source data; submit corrections and updates here

## API and documentation

- [API documentation](https://www.openbrewerydb.org/documentation): endpoint reference for targeted lookups
- [API](https://api.openbrewerydb.org/v1): REST API base URL
- [FAQ](https://www.openbrewerydb.org/faq): licensing and usage questions
